payload.title: tasks.md meets every new-project requirement (or waives it with a reason)
payload.body: Outcome: tasks.md meets all 10 new-project required areas (vision, metrics, observability, user-stories, setup, e2e, self-improving, tasks, checkup, caching), each met, mapped in .agents/requirements.yaml, or waived with a reason. Audit 2026-10-16: path score 7/22 (31%); by intent 0 met, 6 partial, 4 missing (metrics, self-improving, checkup, caching). Ordered gaps: (1) add the 5 prereg fields to every task and turn on --require-prereg in npm run lint; (2) .gitignore: .env, .env.*, !.env.example, *.pem, *.key, .metrics/, plus a lefthook pre-commit secret scan; (3) VISION.md: numeric dated adoption goal, pivot, command, dated Kill criteria, refresh last_reviewed, drop the Windsurf/Devin line; (4) docs/metrics.md + scripts/metrics.sh: adoption (code search), npm weekly downloads per package, gate time, lint false-positive rate, each with goal/pivot/command, (stub) when no data; (5) one contributor setup command (npm ci, build, test, lint, tasks doctor) first in CONTRIBUTING; (6) end init --install output and the setup prompt with tasks doctor; (7) Metric: and Tests: lines per story plus a drift check in scripts/check-docs-contract.mjs; (8) stranger-install e2e from the packed CLI in an empty temp repo; (9) e2e for US06 and US10; (10) content-free JSONL events and error->story map for tasks watch, tasks-mcp, fleet claims (docs/observability.md); (11) a fix command on every doctor warn/fail line; (12) a repo-wide checkup command (npm run checkup: doctor, cached gate, metrics, open P0s, monthly audit-due); (13) caching: gate steps and workspace tests cached by input hash (Nx or Turborepo across packages/*), full rerun on any change, NO_CACHE=1 forces; (14) timed gate steps + speed review inside the checkup; docs/learnings.md (predicted vs observed); (15) docs/decisions/ ADRs (git-native dogfood, backend plugins); (16) CHANGELOG generated at release. Push back already accepted: keep root VISION.md and tasks doctor (map them); JSONL logs only for long-running parts; no external error reporter; lint fixture tests (not e2e) for writing-guidance stories US02/US08. Hypothesis: meeting the areas makes contributor and agent work measurable; the setup score rises from 31% to 100% (mapped/waived honestly). Measurement: bash ~/.claude/skills/new-project/scripts/check-setup.sh . --profile tool. Success: 100% with every waiver reasoned, and the monthly audit (tooling-checkup) finds no new gap. Pivot: an area that costs more than it returns here becomes a waiver or a requirement-change PR on agentbrew new-project. Anchor: agentbrew skill-plugins/workflow/new-project/references/owner-practices.md and requirements-map.md; audit 2026-10-16.
